title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing adoption spreads through a population under social influence, policies, information, and supply constraints, and how adoption affects infectious disease transmission.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People influence each other's mask-wearing decisions through their social network; perceived social norms update adoption probabilities.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Information sources broadcast messages that update individuals' risk perception, beliefs, and compliance.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement_event
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement actions affect individuals' compliance and impose penalties for non-use in certain locations.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to price and inventory constraints.

interactions.name: location_based_contact
interactions.description: Contacts occur at locations; transmission risk is modulated by mask use, location type, and occupancy.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum daily adoption fraction reached during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches 70%.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total number of infections over the simulation period.

metrics.name: effective_Rt
metrics.description: Time-varying effective reproduction number estimated from simulated incidence.

metrics.name: mask_supply_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days with retailer inventory below a defined threshold per capita.

metrics.name: enforcement_cost
metrics.description: Aggregate cost of policy enforcement and fines administered.

metrics.name: inequity_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across demographic groups (e.g., Gini coefficient or ratio of top vs. bottom quantiles).

metrics.name: misinformation_prevalence
metrics.description: Average belief_misinformation_score or fraction of population above a misinformation threshold over time.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate must remain within [0, 1] at all times.

validation_criteria.name: nonnegative_counts
validation_criteria.description: All counts (infections, inventory, population) remain nonnegative; no mass-balance violations for inventory.

validation_criteria.name: monotonicity_with_efficacy
validation_criteria.description: Holding all else equal, higher mask efficacy parameters should not increase cumulative infections.

validation_criteria.name: policy_effect_direction
validation_criteria.description: Activating a mandate with enforcement should not reduce adoption relative to no-mandate baseline.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_stability
validation_criteria.description: Key aggregates (adoption rate, Rt) stabilize or exhibit plausible dynamics without numerical explosions.
